scenes.text: Setting up your kid's first phone? Do this before it leaves your hands.

scenes.title: Set it up as a child account.
scenes.body: Not with your own login — **the controls depend on it.**

scenes.title: Decide the phone's bedtime now.
scenes.body: Where it charges at night, and from what time. **Easier to start with a rule than add one later.**

scenes.title: Start with fewer apps.
scenes.body: Add them **one at a time, with approval,** as they show they can handle it.

scenes.title: Write a phone agreement together.
scenes.body: One page: what's okay, what isn't, and **what happens if it's broken.**

scenes.sub: Free — with a printable agreement template.
